subject: maths
question:
Which of the following two will provide more volume?

I) A cuboid of edges 6 cm, 7 cm and 8 cm

II) A cube of edge 7 cm
solution:
Given:

I) A cuboid of edges 6 cm, 7 cm and 8 cm

II) A cube of edge 7 cm

 

Concept used:

The volume of a cuboid = lbh

The volume of a cube = a3

**Calculation:**

The volume of a cuboid = lbh

⇒ 6 × 7 × 8 

⇒ 336 cm³

The volume of a cube = a³ = 7³ = 343

Therefore Cube will have more volume.

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
